description: Full details for one id returned by search, for example esim:GB (every plan and price for that destination). Prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria; pass currency to choose.

currency.description: Optional: USD or NGN. By default prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira inside Nigeria, from where the request comes from.

id.description: An id from search, for example esim:GB.

name: fetch
